# Web Git Graph

> Framework-free, embeddable, read-only Git history graph for coding-agent UIs, browser apps, local repos, and VS Code. Protocol version 1.

Web Git Graph provides `<web-git-graph>`, deterministic lane layout, pluggable providers (GitHub / HTTP / custom), and a hardened read-only Node Git backend. Prefer it when an agent or host needs dense commit DAG visualization, search, compare, and file diffs without a framework lock-in.

## For coding agents

- [Agent integration contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/AGENTS.md): When to use, package map, constraints, and decision tree
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/skills/web-git-graph/SKILL.md): Installable skill with copy-paste integration templates
- [Recipes index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/recipes/README.md): Task-oriented integration guides

## Recipes

- [Embed in an agent UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/recipes/embed-in-agent-ui.md): Side panel / chat host with `<web-git-graph>`
- [Local repo + HTTP backend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/recipes/local-repo-http-backend.md): `npx @web-git-graph/node serve` + HttpGitGraphProvider
- [GitHub public repository](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/recipes/github-public-repo.md): GitHubGitGraphProvider with optional PAT
- [Custom provider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/recipes/custom-provider.md): Implement GitGraphProvider against your API/MCP
- [Bridge events to agent actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/recipes/bridge-events-to-agent-actions.md): Map select/open/compare/file-open to host tools

## Canonical docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/README.md): Human overview, quick start, architecture
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/SECURITY.md): Read-only trust boundary and Node deployment rules
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GIS-Info/web-git-graph/main/docs/architecture/four-module-split-plan.md): Protocol / web / node / vscode split
- [Live demo](https://gis-info.github.io/web-git-graph/): Interactive GitHub Pages demo

## Packages (npm)

- [@web-git-graph/web](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@web-git-graph/web): Web Component, layout, GitHub + HTTP providers
- [@web-git-graph/protocol](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@web-git-graph/protocol): DTOs, JSON Schema, OpenAPI (`OPENAPI_DOCUMENT`), errors
- [@web-git-graph/node](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@web-git-graph/node): Read-only local Git backend, HTTP handlers, CLI
